description:
Goal
Every compiler2/fz2 production emitter passes existing semantic authorities by reference and direct scalars. Handlers alone inspect, transform, format, or retain callback-scoped values. With no matching handler, telemetry performs no payload construction, traversal, transformation, or allocation, and NullTelemetry can erase the call path.

Established corrections
World definition APIs borrow stable keys and clone only for semantic storage. Scheduler completion carries World + JobCompletion, with one activation completion event. Telemetry-only native codegen projections/counters and shadow Value schemas are deleted. Runtime program output is a synchronous semantic OutputSink rather than telemetry; retaining sinks copy explicitly. Destructor closure-unpack failures propagate through the interpreter Result rather than being staged/swallowed by telemetry.

Rejected guard model
A source-AST provenance guard cannot prove that an owned value was constructed independently of telemetry. A naive type-agnostic trace reports 45 instances / 30 unique groups in 12 production files: 15 parameter/self/place projections, 1 reference-returning lookup, 25 independently used owned semantic products, and 4 values with no non-telemetry sink. Syntax cannot distinguish publish(value) from drop(value) without type/effect/API knowledge. The attempted primitive type-name allowlist was a compensation and still admitted `let tmp = make_world(); emit(&tmp)`. It is rejected. Return is an observable sink; dead assignment and empty branch are not.

Proven model
Typed borrowed event boundaries and authority relocation/pass-through are the architectural proof. Persistent facts emit World + stable key after the authoritative mutation. Ephemeral semantic products are borrowed directly before move/clear. Dynamic metadata is constructed only in handlers/adapters after enablement. New telemetry DTOs are forbidden because they recreate a shadow model. The AST guard is reduced to a local no-work/API-inventory lint; it must not infer whole-program semantic provenance, branch by type-name, or implement name/arity pseudo-resolution.

Required migration
Remove the scalar type-name allowlist, home-grown interprocedural provenance graph, and fixtures that treat an observable return as laundering. Classify/migrate the 30 groups by authority lifetime. Move the four no-independent-sink cases to their real boundaries: product-drive completion; the semantic dump activation inventory currently transported by two telemetry events; wait-for-type registration receipt. Reconsider exposing ActivationReturnDecision and RuntimeModuleRegistration solely so handlers can downcast internal mutation receipts. Delete obsolete schemas/events/visibility once the typed boundary no longer consumes them.

Signal
Typed event APIs accept only borrowed semantic authorities/direct scalars and all transformations live in handlers. A no-handler probe proves no projection/allocation/traversal. Local guard fixtures reject direct transformations, pre-bound telemetry-only construction, aliases, UFCS/eager APIs, and computed temporaries without pretending to prove semantic intent. Runtime OutputSink pointer/retention/lifetime, interpreter/JIT/AOT/CLI parity, destructor propagation, full cargo test --lib with zero failures, fmt, all-target/all-feature check, strict clippy, and release fixture 00181 with/without JSON telemetry all pass. Trace remains bounded and contains no runtime.dbg or bad_dtor_closure event.

Final model
RawSpanTelemetry selects a signature-specific associated guard: NullTelemetry returns the zero-sized non-dropping NullSpan, while ConfiguredTelemetry returns the timed RAII Span. ConfiguredTelemetry routes raw events by exact type/arity and raw lifecycle by prefix without payload registration. Emitters pass existing references/direct scalars; Jsonl, diagnostics, stats, and tests transform or retain inside handlers. Product completion is product.settled(ProductKey, ProductValue) only after successful memo settlement; waits are not completion events. Requested types/activations/backend/native/FNIR/CLIF output is synchronous RequestedOutputSink delivery, not telemetry. Legacy dynamic lazy helpers are test-only; obsolete World telemetry ownership, ActivationReturnDecision telemetry receipt, telemetry DTO/projection counters, dump events, product requested/produced/waited/finished aliases, and redundant AOT build span are removed.

Acceptance evidence
cargo test --lib: 1413 passed, 6 ignored, zero failed. cargo fmt --check, cargo check --workspace --all-targets --all-features, and strict clippy are clean. The full fz2 CLI suite remains at 17 passed / 2 inherited selective-receive failures / 0 ignored; fz-1ah.13 tracks those failures. Final release 00181 warm builds are 0.05s wall for no log handler, JSONL, and stats across five runs each, with empty stderr in no-log mode. Each JSONL build trace contains 1053 records and 313205-313280 bytes. The optimized real Null front door calls the Null lexer monomorph; that lexer contains no Span/drop, clock, dispatch, handler, or ConfiguredTelemetry symbols. The adjacent Configured lexer monomorph retains start_raw_span2, conditional clock acquisition, dispatch_raw_event3, and RAII Span drop. Null interpreter and runtime monomorphizations contain no telemetry dispatch, handler, or ConfiguredTelemetry symbols; the runtime clock call is its scheduler deadline check.
title: Migrate raw-authority telemetry handlers and audit event payloads
